key_insight: PaperBanana automates the creation of publication-ready academic illustrations by orchestrating specialized agents (reference retrieval, content & style planning, rendering, and iterative refinement) powered by VLMs and image-generation models.
problem_solved: Research teams and autonomous AI scientist systems face a time-consuming bottleneck producing high-quality, publication-ready figures; PaperBanana removes manual effort by end-to-end automating figure generation and polishing.
method: Agentic pipeline: modular agents for reference retrieval, visual content & style planning, image rendering, and iterative refinement.
Multimodal backbone: use VLMs to parse paper content and specify visual requirements, and image-generation models to synthesize high-fidelity illustrations with style control.
Quality control loop: automated reference matching, layout/style checks, and iterative edits to meet publication standards.
impact: Speeds up paper production and improves visual communication quality for AI/ML researchers and autonomous research agents, lowering the barrier to polished figures and faster dissemination.
visual_elements: Pipeline flowchart showing agents: Retrieve → Plan → Render → Refine

Quality-check dashboard (reference alignment, resolution, reviewer feedback loop)
paper_title: PaperBanana: Automating Academic Illustration for AI Scientists
paper_authors: Dawei Zhu, Rui Meng, Yale Song, Xiyu Wei, Sujian Li
